nativeBaseline.reference: span (decorative) or hr (semantic thematic break, outside Divider)

library: Preserve original decorative aria-hidden on unlabeled Divider with the original 1px CSS geometry
Expose an optional text label as native readable content, not as an ARIA separator role
Provide start/center/end logical positioning on either line axis and visible forced-colors segments
consumer: Provide short, localized text that conveys useful context; do not insert interactive children
Provide independent headings/fieldset relationships where semantic grouping is required
Ensure vertical-line parent has measurable block height; maintain readable contrast and adequate room for label expansion

notes: An unlabeled Divider is decorative and aria-hidden; a labeled Divider exposes its text to assistive technology, with no role=separator.
Visual Divider remains a composition primitive distinct from native thematic hr and context-owned interactive separators.
Native writing-mode vertical-rl renders vertical label text; human visual and assistive-technology acceptance remains separate.
